CLIP (with atom IDs): E08.034 | 01:06.00-01:11.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Corin toward Selene.
E08.035 | 01:06.40-01:09.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (O.S., cold, nervous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E08.036 | 01:11.00-01:15.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from the Mayor toward the widow.
E08.037 | 01:11.20-01:15.00 | ACT | the widow tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E08.038 | 01:11.40-01:14.44 | DLG | SELENE (cruel, mocking) | "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
E08.039 | 01:15.00-01:20.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E08.040 | 01:20.00-01:23.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E08.041 | 01:20.40-01:22.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E08.042 | 01:23.00-01:27.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Selene's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E08.043 | 01:23.20-01:27.00 | ACT | Selene slaps the cup from the widow's hand and it shatters.
E08.044 | 01:23.40-01:26.80 | DLG | CORIN (dangerous, cold) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E08.045 | 01:27.00-01:33.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Selene as the lamp flickers behind them.
E08.046 | 01:27.20-01:33.00 | ACT | Selene steps between Corin and the crowd.
E08.047 | 01:27.40-01:30.82 | DLG | CORIN (dangerous, calm) | "Say her name again and you will regret it."
E08.048 | 01:33.00-01:36.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E08.049 | 01:33.40-01:35.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, afraid) | "Your father paid me to watch over you."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
